src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: How many Sutralu (Guiding Principles) were proposed to help achieve the goals of Swarna Andhra Vision 2047?
x: The CM proposed ten Sutralu (Padi Sutralu, guiding principles) for Swarna Andhra Vision 2047, starting with Zero Poverty (P4) and including population management, employment and skilling, water security, agri-tech, logistics, energy cost, product perfection, Swachh Andhra and deep tech. 5, 7 and 9 are wrong counts.

s: Financial Responsibility and Budget Management Act was introduced in the year
x:
Most books and keys: 2003 (year of enactment). Strictly, the FRBM Bill was introduced in Parliament in 2000 and the Act came into force on 5 July 2004 (Ramesh Singh p.19); AP's own FRBM Act is of 2005 (India Code, AP Act 34 of 2005).
The (Union) Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act was enacted in 2003 (26 August 2003) and came into force on 5 July 2004; it is what books call 'the FRBM Act, 2003'. The FRBM Bill was first introduced in Parliament in December 2000, and Andhra Pradesh's own FRBM Act is of 2005, so 2000 and 2005 are traps.
